title: Genie Migrate is generally available for SQL conversion
body:
Genie Migrate, formerly the agentic code converter, is now generally available for the **SQL** target framework. Powered by Genie Code, it converts SQL from dialects such as T-SQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, BigQuery, and Teradata into Databricks SQL queries. You organize the work in a migration project, and Genie Migrate validates the output and fixes errors before writing the results to a workspace folder. After a conversion, you can continue chatting with Genie Code about the converted files to address action items or summarize the changes.

See [Convert SQL with Genie Migrate](/aws/en/migration/agentic-code-converter).
